leadText:
Woody Park (Japanese: 森林公園 Forest Park) is an -exclusive location located in Johto. It appeared in The Pokémon Center Lady.

The park is located near Mochew City and is described as a hiking trail that even beginners can enjoy, a fact attributed to the lack of aggressive wild Pokémon. The Exceed Testing Center is also located nearby, and the recent development of the Strong Spheres resulted in wild Pokémon being affected by Laquium.

Mollie occasionally ventures into this place in order to treat injured Pokémon when she is not working at her family's Pokémon Center.
